messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: problems with runExample(...) etc.
parts:
The problem is that CRAN is building binaries for Windows using R 3.0.1, and these won't work properly on R 3.0.0. If you install R 3.0.1 (and update shiny and httpuv), it should work. See this thread for more info:
https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shiny-discuss/poNAAtyYuS4/rTa0cY7MDyIJ
